Resumen:
Conversion rates for new transactions on Transbank (Chile) have improved and are trending back toward nominal levels. Approval rate remains within nominal range throughout. We are continuing to monitor to confirm the improvement holds and that previously affected transactions reach a final state. Root cause analysis remains in progress with the processor.
